card.name: Word right after in, for or used
card.fires_on: A word that comes straight after a preposition or verb such as in, for, after or used, and that begins a qualifier. Typical words are just, only, patients, subjects and to.

modes.label: Population noun after in/for
modes.description: The words patients or subjects follow in or for when naming a group studied or treated.
modes.example: The risk of fracture was increased in<< patients>> who received high-dose, defined as

modes.label: Quantity or time adverb
modes.description: The words just or only come before a short span of time or an amount.
modes.example: it will pay for itself in<< only>> 8-14 months. The

modes.label: Verb or linking word
modes.description: Words such as to, used or for follow a verb and lead into a purpose or past habit.
modes.example: Kamrul used<< to>> carry the stuff of other people on his

card.plain: It fires on the small word after a preposition that opens a group, an amount or a purpose, such as in patients or in only.
